sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: An unconventional priest from the Randall Empire. Long ago, Leric rescued some women who had been confined to a mansion, and then tried entrusting them to the church. However, the church was hesitant to take them in, and thus he decided to leave the Federation with them in tow, pawning his sacred relics to provide the ladies with enough money to run away on their own. Outraged by his actions, the church demanded that Leric return home, but upon catching word about the existence of a certain ghost, he decides to make for the ruins where the Empire and Federation are at conflict instead.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Sacred Guidance Leric |bf2 = true }} '''Leric''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== An unconventional priest from the Randall Empire. Long ago, Leric rescued some women who had been confined to a mansion, and then tried entrusting them to the church. However, the church was hesitant to take them in, and thus he decided to leave the Federation with them in tow, pawning his sacred relics to provide the ladies with enough money to run away on their own. Outraged by his actions, the church demanded that Leric return home, but upon catching word about the existence of a certain ghost, he decides to make for the ruins where the Empire and Federation are at conflict instead. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Leric |element = Light |image1 = Navi chara bf2 172 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 172 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 172 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 172 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 172 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 172 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
